method.similarity_method: 64-bit difference hash (dHash), 9x8 grayscale resampling; exploratory only, threshold not calibrated
method.visual_inspection_note: All 16 originals were directly rendered and inspected in a compatible browser workflow. The four previously pending images were checked at their raw GitHub URLs; no derivative files were created.

similarity.interpretation: Distances are only a rough sorting aid. Shared background/style affects them; none is declared duplicate or near-duplicate solely from dHash.

recommendation.reason: All 16 references were visually reviewed, but they remain stylized illustrations with opaque decorative backgrounds, inconsistent poses/crops, no standardized orthographic front/side/back set, no neutral A/T pose, and no validated production landmarks or 3D data.
